domestic_evidence: No public GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic/export split could be retrieved: web_search returned no results (searx connection refused) and thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403. Nothing found either way — not evidence of absence.
note: Export side is factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L records, not by website claims: outbound consignments to Warsaw, Poland (HS 30049069, BOL 1135861, 2026-02-28) and recurring flows to Actavis/Teva entities in the USA and Poland. Declared HS 300410 (penicillins) does not match the observed export HS 30049069 (other medicaments, n.e.s.) — per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground; the company stays in the base and the factual code should be recorded as 30049069. Note the ImportKey record is a two-way trade profile: the same page mixes exports with imports of USP reference standards (HS 38229090), so shipment counts must not be read as export-only. Domestic supply evidence is null/unknown — no GST turnover band, tender or contract data was publicly accessible with the tools used; this is not a finding that domestic supplies are absent.
